scope.server: Space server, AMD Eng Sample 100-000000896-02; 64 physical cores pinned on the same socket for the simulation, single Uvicorn relay process, Redis and Postgres.
scope.players: One Node worker with the current game engine per synthetic pilot. Workers are spread across three Node processes with a single coordinator and a common per-tick barrier. Each pilots a Chapter 04 aircraft. One synchronized kinematic replica supplies the paired aircraft for collision. The server relays via the real Space WebSocket route, including its current pose batching.
scope.scene: Nature test coordinates and runtime World terrain API; no terrain chunks loaded for this airborne test. No GPU rendering or GUI. Root and rotating propeller are separately collision-enabled, 128 rpm.
scope.timing: 500 fixed steps, 25 simulated seconds, target 20 Hz. Step time covers replica sampling, process IPC, all-worker barrier and enqueue of outgoing frames. lateDeadlines also counts accumulated scheduling lateness. pose-network rates were measured over the same simulation window.
scope.cpu: Simulation plus synthetic clients are measured with cgroup v2 cpu.stat normalized to 64 assigned cores. Relay CPU is Uvicorn process time over the same interval. Database and cache CPU are outside those two measurements.
scope.network: Average throughput from the local relay perspective, on an isolated single-host Docker network, including protocol overhead. Does not measure bandwidth or latency over a public internet connection.
scope.rapier: Current production Rapier loader with pin validation. Counts record selected native and compatibility solver substeps. The collision-enabled propeller is a separate body, which makes the aircraft ineligible for the resident Rapier path.
scope.startup: Two attempts with 96 workers in one Node process failed during startup with V8 allocation errors. All compared runs use three pilot processes, each starting workers in groups of eight, and the same 52 GiB cgroup memory limit. Startup is outside the measured simulation window.
